title: AutoBalance: Fairness-Aware Dataset Augmentation Tool
summary: AutoBalance is an interactive Streamlit tool for detecting, analyzing, and mitigating representation bias in tabular datasets by generating synthetic data to balance underrepresented groups and evaluate fairness/utility trade-offs. It directly imports and instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality) to run the actual data augmentation and quality assessment.
